about: One billow of a burning building's smoke column: lumps on lumps of soot, each a pyroclastic sphere creased between its bumps (billow.ts), self-shadowed and lit six ways as shipped games' six-way smoke flipbooks are (Unity's VFX Graph six-way samples), its bumps rolling up over it as it ages and opens. The blaze's column is 8 of these; each frame is fitted to its frame (fit), so a 10 m card draws the billow whole at 256 texels, a 4x4 sheet in one layer.
